risk_note: RV2 path (payout), log only: no money moves, no status or decision changes, no contract, no migration (withdraw lane, model Claude Fable 5.1; orchestrator D10-707 ①, FU-B205Q-LOG-9). After the automatic payout decision records a BR-WDR-29 ⑨ blacklist hit (B2-05q), auto-payout.ts now writes one info line auto_payout_blacklist_hit with app_id, withdrawal_id, the dimension and the rule code — never the member id, a phone or any digest (BR-ID-33; app_id confirmed by the orchestrator, D10-710). Only a decision that recorded a hit logs it; a logger without info logs nothing and does not fail. The line is written inside the decision, so a decision rolled back and redelivered may log it again; risk_hits stays the record. Real risk: personal data in the worker log — the rule tests read every line of the real worker assembly's output and pin the hit line by exact equality. Full verification is the required CI checks (approvals 21; AWS runners disabled, D10-555); the red run and the implementation's run of the task's rule tests were made in the local Docker container.
